gulf-of-california.text: The vaquita lives only in the northern Gulf of California. No other whale, dolphin, or porpoise has such a small range.

black-sea.text: A Greek trading ship survived intact more than two kilometres beneath the Black Sea. The deep water lacks oxygen, allowing even ancient wood to survive.

lake-1159127099.text: Ngāti Tūwharetoa fishers lowered bundles of bracken fern to the lakebed. Freshwater crayfish sheltered among the fronds, and the fishers lifted the bundles into their canoes.
